name: Isaac Forrest
original_name: アイザック・フォレスト
source:
One of Toshirou's few friends. He runs a bar.

Friendly, handsome and cheerful, he is always willing to offer an advice. Due to his job, he is very well informed and provides intel for Toshirou.
